subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Pentacarbonylhydridoiron(II)（[HFe(CO)₅]⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square planar
D. Linear
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Fe (group 8) 8 e; 1 × H (X) 1 e; 5 × CO (L) 10 e; the 1+ charge removes 1 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex has a 1+ charge, so the metal is Fe(II), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e. Fe(CO)₅ protonated on the metal: protonation is an oxidation of the metal by two.
